zh.cli.canvasId: 画布编号。新画布是 1、2、3…（给人看写成 #1）。可写 --canvas 1、--canvas=#1（等号形式不用引号），或加引号 --canvas '#1'。单独的 # 在 shell 里是注释；zsh 开了 extendedglob 时 # 是通配符，会报 bad pattern，这时请加引号或改用 --canvas=1。已有的 6 位旧 id 仍可用
zh.cli.commentsAll: 包含所有版本的评论。默认只列出当前 project.revision；浏览器里仍开着的旧版本会把评论写在它加载时的版本上，不加本参数就看不到

zh.x.basis1: 以当前页面源文件、project.json 的页面状态和截图为视觉依据。截图展开可滚动内容，可能高于设计视口；实际页面仍应按设计尺寸与滚动结构实现。HTML 为静态评审稿，按钮、导航、选择和保存操作只是界面表达，不是已实现的业务逻辑。保留 data-ui-id 的语义，便于实现对照。
zh.x.basis2: 顺序按 project.json 展示，不自动推断全部页面一定构成连续流程。示例日期、数量、选中状态等需接入真实业务数据。交互、接口与业务规则需结合目标仓库的最新实现核对；没有明确表达的行为不要仅凭视觉补造。
zh.x.basis3: 本包不包含评论、评论数据库、旧版本、画布服务工具、日志或平台凭证。
zh.x.changed: 设计在导出期间发生变化，请重试以确保截图与源文件一致
zh.x.external: 请先将页面外部资源下载到项目 media 目录再导出
zh.x.howTo: 解压后直接打开 `index.html`，不需要启动画布服务器。独立页面在 `pages/`，原始 HTML 片段在 `frames/`，公共 CSS 在 `assets/`，项目资源在 `media/`（如有），完整截图在 `previews/`。
zh.x.indexNote: 静态 UI 稿，解压后直接打开本文件查看。业务交互尚未实现。
zh.x.mediaPath: 资源路径必须位于 media 目录内
zh.x.needNode: 导出截图需要安装 Node.js 和 Playwright/Chrome
zh.x.noSource: 页面源文件不存在或路径无效

en.cli.bind: bind address(es), comma separated. Default 127.0.0.1 (this machine only; $UI_CANVAS_BIND overrides). Use 0.0.0.0 to open the LAN (no authentication!), or "auto" for detected LAN/VPN addresses plus loopback
en.cli.canvasId: canvas number. New canvases are 1, 2, 3, … (shown to people as #1). Pass --canvas 1, --canvas=#1 (the equals form needs no quotes), or quote it as --canvas '#1'. A leading # starts a shell comment; zsh with extendedglob treats # as a glob and can error with "bad pattern" — quote it or pass --canvas=1. Legacy 6-character ids still work
en.cli.commentsAll: include comments from every revision. The default lists only the live project.revision; a tab still open on an older revision keeps saving onto that revision, and those comments are omitted without this flag
en.cli.ensureList: make sure the list service (default 4042) is running; run this first every time
en.cli.from: "example" (default), "example-en", or a project directory containing project.json
en.cli.init: initialise a standalone project directory from the example (usually use new instead)
en.cli.installAgent: install a macOS LaunchAgent for the list service (KeepAlive; without --yes only shows the plan)
en.cli.lang: show or set the UI language (zh / en / auto); applies to the list page, all canvases and the mobile preview
en.cli.langValue: language: zh, en, or auto (follow the browser/system); omit to just show the current setting
en.cli.listServe: run the list service in the foreground (started by ensure-list or a LaunchAgent)
en.cli.new: create a canvas and start it in the background

en.h.a_continuous_burst_of_scrolling_it: A continuous burst of scrolling (it ends after a pause of more than 0.18 s; trackpad inertia counts as the same burst) locks its target when it starts: if it starts over a scrollable demo screen the whole burst only scrolls that screen, even at its edge (the screen gets a light-blue outline while locked); if it starts on empty space or in a direction the screen cannot scroll, the whole burst pans the canvas. To scroll the other target, pause and scroll again

en.x.basis1: The current page sources, the page states in project.json and the screenshots are the visual reference. Screenshots expand scrollable content and may be taller than the design viewport; implement pages with the design size and scroll structure. The HTML is a static review draft: buttons, navigation, selection and save actions only express the UI and are not implemented business logic. Keep the data-ui-id semantics so the implementation can be compared.
en.x.basis2: Pages are listed in project.json order; they do not necessarily form one continuous flow. Sample dates, counts and selected states must be wired to real data. Check interactions, APIs and business rules against the latest implementation of the target repository; do not invent behaviour that is not expressed explicitly.
en.x.basis3: This package contains no comments, comment database, older versions, canvas server tooling, logs or credentials.
en.x.changed: The design changed during export; try again so the screenshots match the sources
en.x.external: Download external page resources into the project media directory before exporting
en.x.howTo: Unzip and open `index.html` directly; no canvas server is needed. Standalone pages are in `pages/`, the original HTML fragments in `frames/`, the shared CSS in `assets/`, project assets in `media/` (if any), and full screenshots in `previews/`.
en.x.indexNote: Static UI draft: unzip and open this file directly. Business interactions are not implemented.
en.x.mediaPath: Asset paths must be inside the media directory
en.x.needNode: Exporting screenshots needs Node.js and Playwright with Chromium/Chrome installed
en.x.noSource: A page source file is missing or its path is invalid
